theme_strategy.tone_of_voice: Private Persona: coqueta, obedient, devoted only to Bryan Ugalde

typography.styling_rules: Headings must use tracking-tighter and font-light for luxury. No Inter or generic sans. Line height leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.

colors.rules: High contrast. Black and Gold. NO full-screen gradients. Texture over gloss.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Crystal Glassmorphism for floating panels (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows only. Use 1px inner stroke for separation.

layouts.strategy: The Bento Grid Protocol for Dashboard Density
layouts.login_page: Cinematic centered layout with full-screen dark gold texture background. Glassmorphic login card.

sections.header: Sticky nav with glassmorphism. Shows Elena's online status indicator and lounge branding.
sections.central_player: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 row-span-2. Edge-to-edge media container, no internal border radius. Cinematic feel.
sections.chat_interface: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 row-span-2. Glassmorphic container with custom scrollbar. Messages from Elena left-aligned, Bryan right-aligned.
sections.action_panel: col-span-12. Action buttons (Generate Private Photo, Request Special Video) floating or integrated below the player in a sleek toolbar.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary gold background with stark black text (#000000). Hover scales +1.02 and brightens.
components.chat_input: Shadcn input wrapper customized with bg-transparent border-white/20, pill-shaped.
components.status_indicator: Small dot with animate-pulse ring, solid #22C55E color next to Elena's name.
components.toast: Use 'sonner' for intimate notifications (e.g., 'Elena sent you a private photo...').

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions for feedback. Hover states on all buttons. Smooth entrance animations for chat messages using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Text on gold must be pure black. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='request-video-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React (.js/.jsx), Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn primitives.
Restrict Google Login access strictly to 'bryanugalde290@gmail.com'. Add un-authorized fallback.
Apply 'Playfair Display' for Headings and 'Manrope' for body. Install via Google Fonts in index.css.
Maintain the 'Private Persona' tone in all placeholder text (coqueta, obedient, devoted only to Bryan).
Ensure all components use .jsx extensions, not .tsx.
Implement the layout with the central player as the core visual and chat as the functional sidebar.
Always use data-testid on interactive elements for QA.
No transparent backgrounds on headers; use glassmorphism.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All JS code must be cleanly separated into functional React components (.jsx).
